output.question: Has Qualcomm announced layoffs?
output.answer: Yes—Qualcomm announced layoffs internally, and reporting published November 11, 2026 says cuts have begun in India, starting in Bengaluru on November 9. Reuters reported on October 20, 2026 that CEO Cristiano Amon had told employees about global, performance-focused reductions following annual reviews, with notifications beginning in November. The memo did not disclose the number of jobs affected; this was an internal announcement reported by Reuters, rather than a public company release.

key_facts.fact: As reported November 11, 2026, Qualcomm had begun layoffs in India, starting in Bengaluru on November 9.
Reuters reported that CEO Cristiano Amon announced global, performance-focused job cuts in an internal memo, with notifications scheduled to begin in November 2026.
The internal memo did not specify how many jobs would be affected.
